lead.headline: Jacobs hurt in the first quarter; a coin flip on Golden
lead.deck: A hand injury after four carries; Pickens and Wilson sat; Mahomes' elbow is Monday's other scan.
lead.body: The bad news first: Josh Jacobs caught his hand in a facemask in the first quarter at New England and is questionable to return after 4 carries for 5 yards; Pierre Strong Jr. took over. That is an injury, not a performance, and the call can't be graded — what matters is Monday's imaging. George Pickens was inactive with shoulder and hamstring injuries and Garrett Wilson with the concussion, both on the bench. Rashee Rice scored 9.9 while Patrick Mahomes played through a throwing-elbow injury that will be scanned Monday. Bloodsports trail Jackrabbits 92.16 to 102.82, about a 49% chance, with Golden on 24.6 and still playing. The Barkley-Tate trade closed RIGHT, 89.0 to 64.6 over Weeks 6-9.
